Descriptions.ShortDescription: Restores recently removed Advanced Sequencer instructions and blocks.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Sequencer Item Recovery is a short-term recovery tool for accidental Advanced Sequencer deletions. It compares the current open sequence with its loaded JSON or working in-memory baseline and lists only removed instructions or blocks. Each row can restore the complete item at its original position. It is not a full undo history or an automatic backup.
